title: Fix JSON parse error from extra trailing brackets in Gemini output

Need to extend the resilient parsing check in the backend (likely in backend/generator.go) to trim extra trailing brackets before unmarshaling.

comments.author: Hussain Chinoy
comments.text: Evaluation Complete: I have reviewed the cross-component reactivity, specifically between app-main.ts/oneup-app.ts and variation-card.ts. The data flow is purely top-down (props down) and only one level deep. variation-card.ts manages its own isolated local state for retries and does not bubble complex custom events back up to the parent application. Since the state architecture is simple and well-encapsulated, migrating to @lit-labs/signals is unnecessary at this time and would add unneeded complexity. We will stick with standard Lit decorators.
